root_cause: When a focused element inside the focus trap is removed from the DOM, the trap's mostRecentlyFocusedNode reference becomes a detached node. The focus-in recovery logic then fails to restore focus within the trap, allowing focus to escape to the document body.
repair_strategy: Add an early guard in checkFocusIn to clear the mostRecentlyFocusedNode if it is no longer attached to the document, ensuring the recovery logic falls back to the initial focus node or first tabbable element.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus remains trapped inside the dialog after removing an item, preserving tab order and preventing focus loss to background elements.
functional_risks: Clearing the MRU node may cause an extra focus adjustment when a detached node is referenced, but this should not affect normal trap operation.
verification_requirements: After pressing Enter on the remove button of an item, the count updates and focus stays inside the basket (#basket:focus-within is true).
Tab navigation continues to wrap correctly within the dialog after item removal.
